cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I ask for your vote, how are you ranking me against your cousin for club president? Give me a criterion, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Competence. He'll finally get our car park resurfaced.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a project, not a measure. Which part of my proposal puts me behind him?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You budgeted for next year. He says he'll do it now; my van's taking a beating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then score timing separately from cost. If I bring the work forward without raising fees, do I draw level? Tell me where that leaves your vote.
